label: Bedroom with a box fan
description: One window, a box fan just inside it blowing into the room, and a person in bed. Try moving the fan or pointing it at the bed.

label: Cross-breeze apartment
description: Two rooms joined by an open door, windows on the north and south walls, wind from the south. Try closing the door or changing the wind.

label: Single-window room
description: An office with one open window. With no second opening, air only trades back and forth through the window ("two-way" flow). Try adding a fan or opening a door.

label: Small house with a window fan
description: Three rooms and a kitchen. A window fan blows out of the kitchen, pulling cool evening air in through the bedroom and living room windows. Try moving the fan to another window.
